question: In Type 2 diabetes mellitus, insulin resistance in peripheral tissues is the ONLY pathophysiological defect — beta-cell function remains normal throughout the disease course.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Actually this is false. T2DM is defined by BOTH insulin resistance AND progressive beta-cell dysfunction. Treating only insulin resistance (e.g., with metformin alone) may become insufficient as beta-cell reserve declines.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this statement is false. T2DM has two parallel defects: insulin resistance AND progressive beta-cell failure (reduced secretion). Both must be understood for management.
